# observe (cloudspider-observe) v1.0.0

The observe bundle (opt-in) for any Kubernetes or OpenShift cluster - Grafana Beyla (eBPF live edges + RED), an OpenTelemetry collector (gateway + node agent), kube-state-metrics, Loki single binary. Its own namespace, least-privilege NetworkPolicies, an SCC only on OpenShift. Local state (no AWS account needed).

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| context | must be the kubeconfig context to install into (a write context) |  | kubeconfig context (not cloudspider-viewer) |
| platform | kubernetes \| openshift | kubernetes | openshift adds SCCs |
| allowPrivileged | must be true or false |  | lets Beyla run privileged |
| profile | must be crc or standard |  | resource profile |
| kubeStateMetrics | must be install or skip |  | skip when the cluster has one |
| logs | must be on or off |  | Loki + log agent |
| lokiStorage | must be like 5Gi (1-99) |  | Loki volume |
| lokiRetention | must be hours, like 72h |  | Loki retention |
| storageClass | is not a valid name |  | Loki's storage class |
| nodeCidr | must be a CIDR like 192.168.126.0/24 |  | node network, for NetworkPolicies |
| viewerUser | is not a valid user name |  | user bound to the viewer role |

## Outputs

- `namespace`
- `privileged`
- `notes`
- `resources`
- `reduced`
- `tags`
- `MANAGED_BY`
- `NAMESPACE`
- `IMAGES`
- `PORTS`
- `NODE_AGENT_PRIORITY`
- `PROFILES`
- `PRIVILEGED_WARNING`
- `REDUCED_NOTE`

- Providers pinned: `@pulumi/kubernetes` 4.34.2, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- No data resources to protect.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.
